assets.purpose: One controlled six-place photographic family: immediate service recognition, readable exact English signs and the envelope/medicine/train/art evidence required to teach the six nouns and functions. Public photographic search supplied the real city/town and continuation environments; generic stock could not guarantee this unified evidence and exact readable signs.
assets.fictional: All six scenes generic, no specific New York/Stowe establishment claim.
assets.edits_crops: No raster edits. Six equal square source cells selected using 300% by 200% CSS backgrounds at 35mm square, preserving natural proportions and complete cell content; A-F remain live text.

boundary: These places have real verified features; learner texts are original simplified descriptions, not quotations or invented interviews. First and continuation photographs are distinct; the later station scene is not a reused crop of the vocabulary train. No image recoloring/generative retouching of stock.
